Name: (AT) Furniture related to Shugo Chara
Author: cakeprprpr
Description:
[b][size=5][quote]Updated on August 29, 2025: The furniture has been optimized (redrawn). If you still need the old version of furniture, you do not need to update.[/quote][/size][/b]
2025/08/29更新：优化（重新绘制）了家具部分，如果您依旧需要旧版本家具，则不需要更新。

2025/08/29更新：家具が最適化されました。以前のバージョンが必要な場合は、更新する必要はありません。




[b]This mod is about the Japanese manga Shugo Chara . If you haven't read Shugo Chara , I highly recommend you to read it. The manga has recently been re-serialized and it also has an anime[/b]

[size=4]This mod is in AT form[/size]


[size=6]₍˄·͈༝·͈˄*₎◞ [/size]



[b]English[/b]：The Shugo Charas in this mod were made by me based on the character designs of [b]Mr. PEACH-PIT[/b], the original author of [b]Shugo Chara[/b]. The posters and paintings are screenshots of the animation. The others are made by me based on the impressions of the characters and the furniture in the room of the heroine Amu. (I used Google Translate)

日本語：このMODのしゅごキャラたちは、漫画家さんの[b]PEACH-PIT先生[/b]のキャラデザを元に描いたピクセル。ポスターの部分はしゅごキャラのアニメ版、他のものは自分で描くものです。全体は主人公のあむちゃんの部屋の印象…以上．

中文：这个模组的守护甜心们是我根据守护甜心的漫画原作者PEACH-PIT老师的人设图制作的，海报挂画是动画的截图，其他均由我根据角色印象和主角亚梦的房间制作的家具。
